---
title: VDS Scores
date: "`r format(Sys.time())`"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
cur_year <- 2024
library(dplyr)

library(lubridate)
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
library(tidyr)
theme_set(theme_bw())
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r load}
cur_year <- 2024
source("load.R")
my_team <- teams %>% filter(year == cur_year, mine) %>% pull(uid)
my_riders <- teams %>%
  filter(year == cur_year & mine) %>%
  select(-name) %>%
  inner_join(team_riders) %>%
  inner_join(riders, by = join_by(pid)) %>%
  inner_join(riders_prices) %>%
  select(-mine, -starts_with("spec_"))



```

## Rider Scores

```{r current_table}
x_my_riders <- my_riders %>%
  left_join(race_results) %>%
   group_by(pid) %>% 
   summarise(results=sum(!is.na(pos))) %>% 
  left_join(my_riders)

races %>%
  filter(year == cur_year) %>%
  inner_join(race_results, by = join_by(event_id, year), suffix = c(".race", ".result")) %>%
  right_join(x_my_riders, by = join_by(pid, year), suffix = c(".race", ".rider")) %>%
  group_by(name.rider, pid, born, country.rider, price, results) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(points)) %>%
  arrange(desc(total)) %>%
  select(name=name.rider, country = country.rider, price, born, results, total) %>% # nolint: line_length_linter.
  datatable(
    options = list(
      pageLength = 25,
      dom = "ft"
    )
  )
```

### Cumulative Score

```{r score_over_year, fig.width=14, fig.height=9}
tmp_cumtbl <- my_riders %>%
  inner_join(race_results) %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(score = cumsum(points))

tmp_lastscore <- tmp_cumtbl %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  slice_max(n = 1, order_by = date, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(date = now())

tmp_init <- tmp_cumtbl %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  summarise(
    date = ymd(paste(cur_year, "02", "01")),
    score = 0,
  )

bind_rows(tmp_init, tmp_cumtbl, tmp_lastscore) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = score)) +
  geom_step(aes(color = name)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_label(data = tmp_lastscore,
              aes(x = date, y = score, label = name),
              hjust = "right") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

### All teams

```{r pdc_teams_table}

pdc_teams_total <- team_results %>%
  filter(year == cur_year) %>%
  group_by(uid, year) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(points)) %>%
  inner_join(teams) %>%
  arrange(desc(total)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(rank=min_rank(desc(total)))

  pdc_teams_total %>%
  select(-mine) %>%
  datatable()

```

### Ranking over year

```{r rank_over_year}

team_results <- team_riders %>%
  inner_join(race_results, relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  filter(year == cur_year)

tmp_results <- team_results %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = date, id_cols = uid, values_from = points, values_fn = sum, values_fill = 0) %>% #
  pivot_longer(!uid, names_to = "date", values_to = "points") %>%
  mutate(date = ymd(date))

tmp_cumtbl <- tmp_results %>%
  group_by(uid, date) %>%
  summarise(score = sum(points)) %>%
  group_by(uid) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(score = cumsum(score))

tmp_ranktbl <- tmp_cumtbl %>% ungroup() %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  mutate(rank = min_rank(desc(score))) %>%
  arrange(date, desc(score), uid)


tmp_ranktbl %>%
  filter(uid == my_team) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = rank)) +
  geom_step() +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "month")

```

```{r rank_cmp, include=FALSE}
tmp_ranktbl %>%
  semi_join(pdc_teams_total %>% filter(rank <= 20)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = rank)) +
  geom_step(aes(color=factor(uid))) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "month")
```
## Race Scores

### Latest Races

```{r latest_races}
team_results %>%
inner_join(my_riders) %>%
inner_join(races, by=join_by(event_id, year)) %>%
left_join(stages) %>%
select(race_name=name.y, date, rider_name=name.x, stage=num, pos, points) %>%
mutate(race = str_trim(paste(race_name, stage))) %>%
  select(date, race_name, rider_name, pos, points) %>%
  arrange(desc(date)) %>%
  datatable()
```

### Best Races
```{r best_races}

team_results %>%
  inner_join(my_riders) %>%
  inner_join(races, by=join_by(event_id, year)) %>%
  select(race_name = name.y, event_id, date, points) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(race_name, event_id) %>%
  summarise(date = min(date), score = sum(points), count = n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(score)) %>%
  select(-event_id) %>%
  datatable()
```
